title: Model providers and keys
subtitle: Your own keys for cloud models, the free models this site offers, and your own server.

vault.title: Key vault
vault.none_body: Keys are kept until this tab is closed. Set a passphrase to keep them on this device, encrypted with a key that only your passphrase opens. The keys of this tab move into the vault.
vault.locked_body: Your keys are stored encrypted on this device. Enter the passphrase to use them in this tab.
vault.unlocked_body: The vault is open in this tab. It locks itself after 30 minutes without activity.
vault.unavailable_body: This browser cannot keep a vault (for example in a private window). Keys are kept until this tab is closed.
vault.passphrase_new_hint: At least 8 characters. It cannot be recovered: if you forget it, forget all keys and add them again.
vault.forget_confirm: Delete every key from this tab and from the vault on this device?
vault.suggest: Keys this browser kept in plain text were moved: they now last until this tab is closed. Set a vault passphrase to keep them on this device, encrypted.

result.created: Vault created. The keys of this tab are now stored in it.
result.wrong: That passphrase does not open the vault.
result.too_short: The passphrase needs at least 8 characters.
result.unavailable: This browser cannot keep a vault.
result.idle: The key vault locked itself after 30 minutes without activity.

error.invalid_key: Use printable characters only (letters, digits, punctuation); a key has no spaces.
error.locked: Unlock the vault first, or set a passphrase.
error.unavailable: This browser cannot keep a vault.
error.storage: The browser did not store it (private window, blocked or full storage).

access.title: Access code
access.body: This site asks for an access code before its relay, its free models, voice and research answer. The code goes only to this site.
access.label: Access code
access.placeholder_saved: Saved; enter a new code to replace it

relay.label: Use the Starpi relay for providers that block browsers
relay.hint: Some providers refuse calls straight from a web page. With this on, such a call is sent once more through this site's relay, which forwards it with your key and keeps nothing. The way that worked is remembered per provider.
relay.reset_done: The next call to each provider tries the direct way first again.
relay.off: Relay fallback off: providers that block browsers cannot be reached.

pool.title: Free models via this site
pool.unreachable: This site offers no free models (it runs without server functions).

key.label: {provider} API key
key.hint_prefix: Keys start with {prefix}. The field never shows a saved key.
key.hint_any: Paste the key exactly as the provider shows it. The field never shows a saved key.
key.mismatch: Saved, but this does not look like a key from {provider}. Use Test key to check it.
key.remember: Keep in the vault on this device
key.remember_locked: Open the vault (or set a passphrase) to keep keys on this device.

test.ok_direct: The key works (direct from the browser).

local.title: Your own server
local.url_hint: An OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Allowed: https:// addresses, http://localhost and http://127.0.0.1.
local.key_hint: Only if your server asks for one.
local.cors_title: Let this site call your server

cors.ollama: Ollama: start it with {setting} set to {origin}.
cors.lmstudio: LM Studio: switch on “{setting}” in the server settings.
cors.llamacpp: llama.cpp: its server accepts calls from web pages without extra setup.

local.chrome: Chrome asks whether this site may reach devices on your local network. Allow it, or the browser blocks calls to your server.
local.relay_never: Calls to your own server always go straight from this browser; the relay never reaches your network.
